notes: The ASV inverts the chain pishtei ha-ets to *the stalks of flax*, so the *of* is placed on the word it stands before (pishtei), which is the dependent in the English; rule 19's default placement on the rectum is the competing reading and is named in the unit note.
*laid in order* is headed on *laid*; rule 44's light-verb reading heading on *order* is the competing one and is recorded.
The active recasting of the passive participle leaves the le unrepresented (rule 40) while its suffix takes the subject pronoun *she* (rule 18).
